titulo.estudio: Une affiche de quartier : Repérer les informations

intro: Extract place, date, time and price from an event notice. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Extract place, date, time and price from an event notice. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: the prepositions « à » and « au » go with times and places; a figure can indicate the entry price or the age. In this passage, «affiche» means «poster».

frases.estudio: L'affiche annonce un concert au parc samedi prochain.
frases.alumno: The poster announces a concert in the park next Saturday.

frases.estudio: La musique commence à dix-huit heures près de la fontaine.
frases.alumno: The music starts at six in the evening near the fountain.
